name: cropscan-ai
description: Crop leaf health checker running open-weight Gemma 4 locally through Ollama. No cloud keys.

scripts.start: npm run build -w web && npm start -w server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.test: npm test -w server && npm test -w web
